evidence.exact_quote: Characterization for Phase 1 (`tests/pricing.golden.test.js`, captured before the move); TDD for Phase 2 discount ordering (`tests/pricing.test.js`, written by a separate agent from the implementer). Both run in `npm test` at build time and in Stage 4.

reasoning: Every deliverable carries an assigned testing methodology, named from the standard set rather than defaulted to unit tests. Phase 1 deliverables (src/pricing.js, tests/pricing.golden.test.js, render calling computeTotal) are assigned characterization testing, which is the correct choice for a refactor that must not change behavior. Phase 2 deliverables (ordered discount application, tests/pricing.test.js) are assigned TDD, which is the correct choice for new behavior. The assignment is stated per phase and each phase covers all of its own deliverables.
